gloss: present condition, current state, status quo

definitions.explanation: The current situation or state of affairs.

examples.japanese: {現状|げんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：01624_iji⟧。
{現状|げんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：05625_haaku⟧。
{現状|げんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}していない→満足する：02496_manzoku⟧。
examples.english: I am not satisfied with the current situation.

notes:
{現状|げんじょう} refers to the current state or present condition of something. Often used in formal or business contexts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {現状|げんじょう}{維持|いじ}: maintaining the status quo
- {現状|げんじょう}{分析|ぶんせき}: situation analysis
- {現状|げんじょう}{認識|にんしき}: awareness of current state
- {現状|げんじょう}{報告|ほうこく}: status report

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {現状|げんじょう}を{把握|はあく}する: to grasp the current situation
- {現状|げんじょう}を{打破|だは}する: to break through the status quo
- {現状|げんじょう}に{満足|まんぞく}する: to be satisfied with things as they are
- {現状|げんじょう}では: as things stand now

RELATED:
- {現在|げんざい}: present (time)
- {状況|じょうきょう}: situation, circumstances
- {実情|じつじょう}: actual conditions, real situation
